messages:
tess: deploy-bot failed trying to promote today's RC to the org repo. ECR rejected with immutability and KMS access denied. Anyone available?

deploy-bot: automated: publish attempt -> aws-ecr 409 TagAlreadyExists; aws-kms DecryptionFailure for target key. repo `redwood/search`, attempted tag `rc-2026-03-21A`, digest sha256:99aa88...77.

michael: CI reused the rc tag again. Builder pushed to ci-redwood/search, deploy-bot tried to mirror into org account. Org registry forbids tag overwrite and requires org KMS key.

infra: short options: (A) pin staging to source digest so QA can continue, (B) do a manual manifest copy into org account using org KMS and reattach cosign attestations, (C) republish under a new unique tag and attach attestation, (D) rollback.

tess: prefer A immediately (fast), then B as manual prep for prod. We have a prod window in ~1.5h; if manual copy + attest finishes in 45m we keep it.

ops-bot: policy: staging digest-pin allowed with explicit approver reaction. Prod promotions remain blocked until org push + attestation validated. React :white_check_mark: to approve staging pin.

qa-bot: smoke queued against sha256:99aa88...77. ETA 5m.

michael: I'll open a quick CI fix PR to append the build id to promotion tags to avoid reuse.

infra: approved for staging pin. ops-bot please set `staging_pinned_digest=sha256:99aa88...77`.

ops-bot: flag set. prod_release_ok=false for this artifact.

qa-bot: smoke passed (5/5). QA signs off for staging.

tess: infra, please proceed with manual mirror into org account when ready. Note: put-image won't transfer attestations automatically; you'll need cosign attach-blob or re-sign in org account.

infra: manual manifest copy starting now. Plan: fetch manifest from CI registry, put-image into org registry with org KMS, then attach cosign blob and run `cosign verify-blob`. Command: ```
aws ecr batch-get-image --registry-id 111111111111 --repository-name ci-redwood/search --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:99aa88...77 | jq -r .images[0].imageManifest > /tmp/manifest.json
aws ecr put-image --registry-id 222222222222 --repository-name redwood/search --image-tag rc-2026-03-21A-<buildid> --image-manifest file:///tmp/manifest.json --kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:...
# attach attestation
cosign attach-blob --name redwood/search@sha256:99aa88...77 --signature cosign.sig --blob attestation.json
cosign verify-blob --signature cosign.sig --blob attestation.json --payload-file /tmp/manifest.json
```

deploy-bot: note: after manual mirror, ops-bot will need to flip `prod_release_ok=true` for this artifact to allow promotions.

infra: manual mirror complete. reattached attestation and `cosign verify-blob` passed. pushed tag `rc-2026-03-21A-<buildid>` in org account.

ops-bot: prod_release_ok=true for artifact sha256:99aa88...77.

release-coordinator: plan for prod: (1) update prod deployment manifests to imageDigest sha256:99aa88...77, (2) dry-run apply to prod-canary, (3) if green -> canary rollout 5%->50%->100% with 5m holds and rollback criteria (errors >1% or p95 latency +20%). I'll start at T-30m.

michael: created PR to append build id to promotion tag; opened ticket DEPLOY-5010 to prevent tag reuse and DEPLOY-5011 to add attestation-preserve logic to deploy-bot.

tess: adding a short note to release notes: "Search: promoted to staging pinned-by-digest due to registry immutability; manual org mirror and attestation reattach completed for prod promotion."

qa-bot: prepping prod canary smoke run. Monitoring hooks in place.

release-coordinator: keeping thread live for status updates during rollout. Thanks all.
